# EBS pollock 2026 {#ebs-pollock-2026}

**Model scope:** Model 26.0 (Rceattle) is the primary model. Model 23.0 provides continuity and comparison. This public checklist contains task descriptions and completion criteria; assessment results and draft files remain private.

The requested inputs are fishery catch, BTS, ATS and AVO indices through 2026; BTS and ATS ages through 2026; and fishery ages through 2025. Preserve each series' actual observation years. Retain the absent 2020 BTS, the corrected ATS 2020 age-1 treatment, and zero composition weight for the absent ATS 2020 age sample.

## Ten data gaps and completion criteria

[Download the data-gap checklist (CSV)](data/assessment-data-gaps.csv) · [Task register (JSON)](data/assessment-tasks.json)

| Task | Initial status | Completion criteria |
|---|---|---|
| Finalize 2025 catch and update 2026 catch | Waiting | Record source, extraction date, units, retained/discarded and CDQ treatment; reconcile final 2025 catch; document the 2026 year-end estimate and its completion method. |
| Update BTS 2025–2026 indices and covariance | To do | Verify actual survey years and coverage; retain estimates, covariance or supplied uncertainty, method version, and comparison with the previous series. Preserve the absent 2020 BTS. |
| Update ATS 2026 index and age-1 series | To do | Validate units, delivered uncertainty, revision, and actual survey years. Preserve the corrected ATS 2020 age-1 treatment and keep the missing placeholder outside fitting. |
| Update AVO index through 2026 | To do | Record processing revision, observation years, coverage and uncertainty; compare revised historical values and document the approved uncertainty treatment. |
| Update BTS age compositions through 2026 | To do | Retain actual survey years, age range, sample sizes, expansion method, age-reading provenance and uncertainty; validate composition totals and years against the index inputs. |
| Receive final ATS 2026 age compositions | Waiting | Confirm final delivery and age-reading method; validate compositions, age range, sample sizes and uncertainty. Preserve zero composition weight for the absent ATS 2020 age sample. |
| Update fishery ages for 2024 and 2025 | To do | Record fish and haul counts, strata, expansion, age-reading method, uncertainty and revision; validate the terminal composition year as 2025 and preserve source age-method labels. |
| Update biological and weight-at-age schedules | To do | Complete the [WtAgeRe update](#wtagere-update) after its four input deliveries. Compare each schedule with the baseline; document sources, units, years, missing-year assumptions, and the rationale for any change. Record cohort and year-effect sigma inputs; compare weight estimates and forecasts between Models 23.0 and 26.0; document forecast-year alignment and weight-uncertainty treatment. |
| Document ageing error and composition weights | To do | Archive matrices and age methods; distinguish sampled fish, starting sample sizes and final likelihood weights; document all adjustments and preserve zero ATS 2020 composition weight. |
| Validate and freeze matched model inputs | To do | Check source revisions, observation schedules, dimensions, units, sums, missingness, ageing error and weights; record changes, checksums and the selected input versions before fitting. |

The catch task waits for the October 1 query and a documented full-year completion estimate. The ATS age task waits for the final 2026 delivery. Move a card to Done after checking its completion criteria and recording the dated evidence in the assessment workspace.

## WtAgeRe update {#wtagere-update}

**Status:** Waiting. **Task:** `ebs26-wtage-re`. **Repository:** [afsc-assessments/WtAgeRe](https://github.com/afsc-assessments/WtAgeRe).

Update WtAgeRe after all four weight-at-age inputs are available and validated:

| Required input | Current dependency |
|---|---|
| Fishery weight-at-age, 2024 | Await accepted delivery and validation |
| Fishery weight-at-age, 2025 | Await accepted delivery and validation |
| Survey weight-at-age, 2025 | Unavailable; await delivery and validation |
| Survey weight-at-age, 2026 | Unavailable; await delivery and validation |

The sampler estimates supply the fishery input stage. The WtAgeRe fit follows that stage and receipt of the survey weights. The local pollock-preparation wiki records this sequence on its **Fishery catch-at-age and weight-at-age** page ([wiki source](https://github.com/noaa-afsc/pollock_prep/blob/main/wiki/fishery-catch-at-age.qmd)). Retain the survey identifiers and actual survey years in each delivery.

After all four prerequisites are complete:

1. Accept and version the inputs. Record sources, units, age and sex definitions, sampling uncertainty, and treatment of missing values.
2. Pin the WtAgeRe revision and configuration, then run the model with cohort and year random effects. Record the sigma values for both effects and identify which are estimated and which are supplied.
3. Verify compilation without warnings, the exit status and logs, a maximum gradient below `1e-4`, and a positive-definite Hessian.
4. Archive estimated and projected weights, uncertainty, and configuration. Compare the results with the prior accepted weights.
5. Document the ADMB input mapping and the November change in weight estimation for Model 26.0 (Rceattle), which presently lacks the ADMB cohort/year random-effect feature with input sigmas. Review the consequences before updating assessment inputs or tables.

This task supplies the existing biological-input task (`ebs26-biological-inputs`). The earlier WtAgeRE age-error development card (`c6`) remains a separate task. The update is scheduled; model execution awaits the four accepted input deliveries. Assessment results and draft files stay in the private workspace.

## Plan Team diagnostics

- [ ] Age-1 BTS selectivity: evaluate alternative penalties and a time-invariant alternative.
- [ ] Simulated-data retrospectives: simulate from fitted Model 26.0, refit, and perform peels.
- [ ] Selectivity across peels: examine retrospective changes in time-varying selectivity.
- [ ] Paired retrospectives: present Models 23.0 and 26.0 with matched data cutoffs and peel years.
- [ ] BTS data influence: examine index volatility, the missing 2020 survey, and supported data or ecosystem explanations.
- [ ] Composition weighting: document starting and final weights and evaluate alternatives with OSA diagnostics.

For each analysis, retain settings, numerical diagnostics, outputs, interpretation and the response to the recommendation. Continue future ESP material as resources allow.

## Legacy workspace retirement

**Status:** Done. The `ebswp_assessment` repository is archived read-only after a verified private backup. Useful 2025 inputs were retained pending validation, and the local source was preserved. Validate the retained inputs before assessment use.

## Rceattle: validate the 5.45.1 package update {#rceattle-version-validation}

**Status:** Done. **Task:** `rceattle-version-validation`. [Board card](kanban.html#rceattle-version-validation).

Completed the September 28 numerical comparison of dev 5.45.1 with the prior 5.23.0 baseline using matched inputs, parameter checks, refits and reference models. Compiler-warning cleanup has its own open task.

**Completion criteria:** Retain pinned revisions, separate package libraries, matched inputs and parameters, likelihood and prediction comparisons, fresh-process refits, reference checks, exit codes and logs. Verify maximum gradients below 1e-4 and positive-definite Hessians; record compiler warnings separately.

**Status basis:** September 28 package-comparison records were rechecked on October 1. This Done status covers numerical equivalence for the tested baseline.

## Rceattle: resolve compiler warnings {#rceattle-compiler-warnings}

**Status:** To do. **Task:** `rceattle-compiler-warnings`. [Board card](kanban.html#rceattle-compiler-warnings).

Follow up on the compiler warnings recorded during the dev 5.45.1 build, including Boolean bitwise operators and Eigen dependency warnings.

**Completion criteria:** Identify package and dependency causes, apply and review the appropriate fixes, rebuild from a clean process without warnings, and repeat the matched-baseline and reference checks. Archive the build log, exit status, source revision, gradients and Hessian checks.

**Status basis:** The saved September 28 installation log contains compiler warnings; warning-free compilation remains open.

## Rceattle: document DSEM and covariate inputs {#rceattle-dsem-guide}

**Status:** Done. **Task:** `rceattle-dsem-guide`. [Board card](kanban.html#rceattle-dsem-guide).

Completed the local Quarto guide and fishery-wiki integration covering dynamic structural equation models (DSEM), equations, flags, annual covariates, lags and recruitment-year alignment. The guide distinguishes dev 5.45.1 from the separate dsem-v5-integration branch.

**Completion criteria:** Retain editable source, pinned implementation links, reproducible input examples and a verified HTML render. Check navigation, figures, internal links and wiki integration. Keep the guide and fitted assessment examples in the private workspace.

**Status basis:** September 28 guide, render-validation records and local wiki integration were rechecked on October 1.

## Rceattle: evaluate DSEM recruitment covariates {#rceattle-dsem-evaluation}

**Status:** In progress. **Task:** `rceattle-dsem-evaluation`. [Board card](kanban.html#rceattle-dsem-evaluation).

Continue the exploratory cold-pool and late-summer SST evaluation on the pinned DSEM integration branch. Pilot fits and effect plots are available locally; predictive checks, sensitivity analysis and assessment-use review remain open.

**Completion criteria:** Version covariate sources, units, scaling, missing values and cohort alignment. Compare models against a reference with the same environmental likelihood; assess forecast performance, influential cohorts and effects on recruitment and biomass. Verify gradients below 1e-4 and positive-definite Hessians, and document the projection-year and DSEM MSE restrictions before extending use.

**Status basis:** September 28 pilot-fit and methods records support completed exploratory work and remaining evaluation.

## Rceattle: resolve spmR projection handoff checks {#rceattle-spmr-handoff}

**Status:** Waiting. **Task:** `rceattle-spmr-handoff`. [Board card](kanban.html#rceattle-spmr-handoff).

The projection replay is reproducible. Assessment use waits for resolution of recruitment variability, population-weight schedules and starting-year alignment in the Rceattle-to-spmR handoff.

**Completion criteria:** Document recruitment units and sex allocation, population/spawning/fishery weights, missing male-weight treatment, starting abundance year and forecast-year alignment. Compare biomass and harvest outputs with matched native projections and the ADMB comparison. Retain input provenance, reproducible checks and a reviewed interpretation before using management tables.

**Status basis:** The September 29 validation summary records successful execution and unresolved scientific checks; follow-up fixes require verification.

## Rceattle: refit Model 26.0 with accepted 2026 inputs {#rceattle-2026-refit}

**Status:** Waiting. **Task:** `rceattle-2026-refit`. [Board card](kanban.html#rceattle-2026-refit).

The private 2026 draft is prepared. The refit waits for accepted catch, survey and age-composition inputs, the WtAgeRe weight update and the matched-input check. Link the resulting fit to the existing Plan Team diagnostics task.

**Completion criteria:** Complete the assessment data tasks and ebs26-wtage-re, then freeze the inputs under ebs26-input-freeze. Pin the Rceattle revision and configuration; compile without warnings and verify logs, exit status, maximum gradient below 1e-4 and a positive-definite Hessian. Complete ebs26-plan-team and projection validation, compare with Model 23.0, and retain the draft and results privately until release is authorized.

**Status basis:** The private 2026 draft and input register record outstanding accepted inputs and model work.

The refit depends on the existing [assessment data checklist](#ebs-pollock-2026), [WtAgeRe update](#wtagere-update), and matched-input task (`ebs26-input-freeze`). The six [Plan Team diagnostic areas](#plan-team-diagnostics) remain under `ebs26-plan-team`; this development checklist links to that work. DSEM evaluation remains exploratory, and the ordinary `dev` package and DSEM integration branch have separate validation records.
